_note: Pass 7 (Owner Tree / Franchise Pillar). Owners have no Tier-1 Origins phase -- unlike QB/MIKE/HB/WR_TE/DB, this catalog starts at Tier 2, and every lane-opener node carries an explicit `requires: []` (gated by Owner XP only, no prerequisite key) rather than relying on the flat tier-count fallback, since that fallback assumes 2 owned Tier-1 picks that will never exist here. Three lanes (Player Development / Organizational Influence / Personnel Authority), each Tier 2 -> Tier 3, converging into one shared Tier 4 capstone -- matches the Pass 10 UI mockup's 3-lanes-to-1-capstone shape (QB/MIKE, by contrast, get one capstone PER branch). xp_cost matches the QB/MIKE Tier 2/3/4 convention (50/90/120) -- pacing is tuned on the earn side instead (see OWNER_WIN_XP/OWNER_SEASON_COMPLETION_XP in owner-progression.service.ts): an average team nets roughly one Tier-2 node per season and finishes the whole tree (3 lanes + capstone, 540 XP) in the neighborhood of the Pass 11 seven-season horizon for an average franchise, faster for a winning one.

characteristics.name: Front Office Access
characteristics.effect: Unlocks standing authority to release (cut) players without a per-move commissioner sign-off, and opens restricted CPU trading (Personnel Council Tier 1).
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: First real organizational trust milestone; Player Development / Personnel Authority lane, Tier 2.

characteristics.name: Personnel Council
characteristics.effect: Full CPU trading authority is unlocked league-wide for this franchise (Personnel Council Tier 2).
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Personnel Authority lane, Tier 3 -- requires Front Office Access.

characteristics.name: Development Program
characteristics.effect: Teammate development-trait promotions cost 20% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Player Development lane, Tier 2 -- funds the roster's dev-trait promotion pipeline.

characteristics.name: Elite Development Pipeline
characteristics.effect: Teammate development-trait promotions cost 35% less Player XP (supersedes Development Program, does not stack with it).
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Player Development lane, Tier 3 -- requires Development Program.

characteristics.name: Investment Office
characteristics.effect: Unlocks Franchise Investments -- invest Owner XP now, mature it into more Owner XP one season later.

characteristics.name: Aggressive Investor
characteristics.effect: Franchise Investments mature at a 15-point-higher return.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Organizational Influence lane, Tier 3 -- requires Investment Office.

characteristics.name: Franchise Pillar
characteristics.effect: Earn +15% Owner XP from all eligible sources.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Shared capstone -- requires the Tier 3 node in all three lanes, matching the Pass 10 UI's 3-lanes-to-1-capstone shape.

characteristics.name: Culture Builder
characteristics.effect: Season-completion Owner XP is boosted by an extra 50 percentage points on top of the base amount.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Pass 9 (Advanced Owner Systems) -- post-capstone, requires Franchise Pillar.

characteristics.name: Roster Architect
characteristics.effect: This team's CPU-trade season cap is raised by 2.

characteristics.name: Master Ability Coach
characteristics.effect: Once per season, grant a bonus ability slot to a Superstar or X-Factor prospect on this team.

characteristics.name: Master Facilitator
characteristics.effect: All REC Coin performance-contract offers on this team are increased by 20% after the normal calculation.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Pass 9 -- post-capstone, requires Franchise Pillar. Reuses the same negotiator-multiplier mechanic Great Negotiator uses at the prospect level.
